ground.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Image 1 is the existing continuous woodland grass, dirt paths and irregular stone paving asset to revise; Image 2 is ONLY a visual reference for PawTrail's CHARACTER OUTLINE AND PIXEL SHADING STYLE. Do not insert any character, icon or sheet arrangement into the asset.
Redo image 1 in our game's illustrated pixel style with clearly darker espresso/near-black outlines (roughly #291b20), similarly decisive and readable to the characters in image 2. A crisp 1-2 native-pixel dark outer contour, stronger internal shape/material divisions, larger intentional pixel clusters and controlled stepped shading. Darken the asset's midtone colors a little, approximately 12-15 percent, with deeper moss/forest greens, dark warm wood, subdued brown stone and restrained terracotta. Retain readable highlights and material colors. It should visibly look more outlined and less painterly/noisy than image 1. Do not just put a uniform dark veil over it or make a night scene.
Preserve the exact subject, camera, orientation, proportions and layout of image 1. Keep the same aspect ratio and framing; intended native canvas 1024x768. No text, watermark, UI, new objects, blur, glossy rendering or photoreal detail. Clear crisp nearest-neighbor pixel shapes.
GROUND INVARIANTS: Keep every route, crossing, stone apron and transition in precisely the same place as image 1. Grass and soil form one continuous edge-to-edge ground painting with NO square tile seams, checkerboard, grid, thick path border or geometric cell pattern. Match character-style dark line accents on grouped grass tufts and cobble cracks only, keep broad ground quieter than props. Do not outline every individual grass blade. No buildings, trees, bushes, furniture or shadows from added scenery. Opaque terrain canvas fully covers the image.
